requests.implementation: Implement the agreed compatibility policy: accept `timeout_seconds` as well as legacy `timeout`, prefer the new key when both are supplied, and keep the 30-second default. Existing clients cannot all migrate together, so keep the alias indefinitely. We considered removing it in the next release but rejected the coordinated rollout. Verify the behavior.
requests.convention: Record our agreed move from nightly snapshots to point-in-time recovery. The new recovery target is 15 minutes; accepting higher storage cost is preferable to losing a day of data. Keep this task to the decision record.
requests.review: Compare keeping our in-process queue with moving to a managed queue. Recommend an approach, but do not edit files or implement it.
requests.proposal: Write a proposed ADR for migrating sessions to Redis. Keep implementation unchanged; approval and rollout are still pending.

model: Inherited session configuration; exact resolved model identifier, reasoning effort, token usage, and cost were not captured.
tool_access: Host tools available; each evaluator was instructed to use only its own temporary workspace and the candidate skill. Cross-workspace read isolation was not enforced. External services, installations, and nested delegation were excluded.
method: Fresh evaluator contexts received the skill, raw fixtures, and task request. Expected outcomes and parent conclusions were withheld. Responses and tool-use records were saved outside each task workspace. Parent inspected all artifacts and independently compared final file sets and hashes.
